stem:
Charu picks two leaves from the school garden. Leaf M shows a thick middle vein with a net-like pattern of thinner veins on both sides. Leaf N shows veins running side by side from base to tip.

Which labelling is correct?

options.text: Leaf M: reticulate venation; Leaf N: parallel venation.
Leaf M: parallel venation; Leaf N: reticulate venation.
Both leaves show only parallel venation.
Both leaves show only reticulate venation.

teacher.key_rationale: A net-like pattern beside a thick middle vein is reticulate venation. Veins running side by side are parallel venation. Reversing the labels swaps the relationship.
